direction: Wilder daily RSI pullback in a fixed SMA200 regime.
hypothesis: Test whether recursively smoothed oversold pullbacks within a positive long-term price regime can recover enough to pay costs. Wilder periods7/14/28 differ from the rejected finite-window CutlerRSI2 tests; this generated hypothesis is not established profitability evidence.

sources.scope: Primary Wilder gain/loss initialization and recursive smoothing definition. Independently implemented Decimal math; neutral50 when gain+loss=0 is our explicit convention rather than TA-Lib zero.
Original Wilder reference and oscillator definition, not evidence for this exact trading rule.
Official filter definitions; historical filters remain unavailable.

rule.signal: From dataset day0 completed closes, seed average gain/loss with simple means of firstL close changes (first score at dayL). Thereafter avg_t=((L-1)*avg_previous+new_gain_or_loss)/L, Decimal28. RSI=100*avg_gain/(avg_gain+avg_loss); when both zero use50. No reset at OOS/fold boundaries. SMA200 includes the current completed signal close.
rule.entry: While flat, enter iff RSI<entry_rsi and close>SMA200, both strict. Equality remains cash.
rule.exit: While long, exit iff RSI>=exit_rsi=50 or close<=SMA200. Exit precedence, no same-decision re-entry.
rule.execution: Signal becomes available at the signal candle close; if target changes, simulate an order at the next UTC day 00:01 one-minute open (60-second delay). Rejected orders are not backfilled; the same desired state may be tried on a later new daily decision. At the frozen OOS terminal timestamp, liquidate any open lot with costs.
rule.account: Independent 2,000 USDT single-asset cash account for every asset×parameter combination; all initial capital assigned to the specified asset sleeve, no leverage, borrowing, shorting, transfer or cash interest.

time_boundaries.walk_forward: 12 consecutive, non-overlapping 30-day evaluation windows; account remains continuous across windows; no fitting, parameter selection or fold reset.
time_boundaries.history_note: The 2025–2026 OOS window has been reused extensively in this repository and is not an untouched final holdout.

validation.neighborhood: Same asset, adjacent lookback index and adjacent hurdle index in the frozen 3×3 grid; 3×3 neighborhood including center.
validation.multiple_testing: No DSR/PBO claim: repeated reused-OOS history and many prior strategy trials create material selection bias.
validation.purging: No predictive fitted model or future-return labels; label purge is inapplicable. Wilder state is seeded on the firstL actual daily changes from the fixed dataset start and carried without resets through warmup and all12folds. The SMA uses only200 completed closes including the current signal day; no OOS parameter selection.
validation.continuous_drawdown: Initial capital plus all OOS minute-close and immediate post-fill marks; no fold reset or intraminute extrema.

costs.impact: 0.5 × sample stdev of previous 20 complete UTC daily log returns × sqrt(order quote budget / previous 20 complete daily quote ADV)
costs.filters_source: Unchanged 2026-10-14 frozen public exchangeInfo proxy, checked against the current public response in filter_check.json. Reuse the original hash so retrieval timestamps cannot manufacture novelty. Historical L2 and historical filters are unavailable.

data.format: Archived Binance spot 1m OHLCV; daily closes and quote ADV are aggregated from fully closed UTC days.

prior_results.last_batch: 18 OLS trend-strength configurations rejected; read-only reference.
prior_results.distinction: Recursive Wilder RSI with periods7/14/28 and new entry thresholds20/30/40; SMA200 fixed. Prior CutlerRSI2 used finite two-change means, thresholds5/10/15 and varied SMA. No prior completed configuration rerun.

source_access_failures.impact: Optional paper lookup returned Too Many Requests. Paper contents were not obtained or used as evidence. Primary TA-Lib definition was available; no price or backtest was synthesized.

account_scope: Offline research only. Read existing paper10 and delayed SMA-shadow accounts without reset, replacement, new paper observations or real orders.
